dict.Bonificația la plata întreagă până pe 31: Discount for paying in full by 31 March
dict.Bonificația și majorările se schimbă pri: The discount and the late charges change by local council decision and by law: check them on the tax assessment and with your accountant.
dict.Impozitele pe clădiri, terenuri și mașin: The taxes on buildings, land and vehicles, with the yearly amount and what you paid: you get the two instalments (31 March and 30 September), the amount with the discount if you pay in full by 31 March, the discount obtained, what is left to pay, the estimated late charges and the status: paid (in green), to pay (in yellow), instalment overdue or overdue (in red).
dict.Impozitul pe an se plătește în două rate: The yearly tax is paid in two equal instalments, by 31 March and by 30 September; whoever pays in full by 31 March gets the discount set by the local council (at most 10%).
dict.Majorări pe fiecare lună de întârziere: Late charges per month of delay
dict.Majorările sunt doar estimate: câte 1% p: The late charges are only estimated: 1% for each month begun after the deadline, on each instalment; payments after 31 March go first to the first instalment. The town hall gives the exact amount.
